// Generate with the public Prometheus v0.305.0 or v0.308.0 module (3.5.0/3.8.0).
// Optional -receiver points at that release's real remote-write receiver with
// created-timestamp-zero-ingestion disabled (the default), native histograms on.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"reflect"

	"github.com/golang/snappy"
	writev2 "github.com/prometheus/prometheus/prompb/io/prometheus/write/v2"
)

const timestamp int64 = 1700000000000

func main() {
	legacy := flag.Bool("legacy", false, "series-level created_timestamp schema")
	receiver := flag.String("receiver", "", "public Prometheus base URL")
	flag.Parse()
	var cases []map[string]any
	for _, kind := range []string{"float", "int_histogram", "float_histogram", "custom_histogram"} {
		for i, start := range []int64{0, timestamp - 12000, timestamp, timestamp + 1, -1, math.MinInt64, math.MaxInt64} {
			name := fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d", kind, i)
			ts := writev2.TimeSeries{LabelsRefs: []uint32{1, 2}}
			starts := []int64{start, start}
			if !*legacy {
				starts[1] = start + 1
				if start == math.MaxInt64 {
					starts[1] = -9
				}
			}
			for j, st := range starts {
				t := timestamp + int64(j)*15000
				if kind == "float" {
					s := writev2.Sample{Value: float64(7 + j), Timestamp: t}
					setStart(&s, st, *legacy)
					ts.Samples = append(ts.Samples, s)
				} else {
					h := writev2.Histogram{Count: &writev2.Histogram_CountInt{CountInt: 1}, Sum: 2, ZeroThreshold: 0.001, ZeroCount: &writev2.Histogram_ZeroCountInt{ZeroCountInt: 1}, Timestamp: t}
					if kind == "float_histogram" {
						h.Count = &writev2.Histogram_CountFloat{CountFloat: 1.5}
						h.ZeroCount = &writev2.Histogram_ZeroCountFloat{ZeroCountFloat: 1.5}
					}
					if kind == "custom_histogram" {
						h.Schema = -53
						h.ZeroThreshold = 0
						h.ZeroCount = nil
						h.CustomValues = []float64{-2, 3}
						h.PositiveSpans = []writev2.BucketSpan{{Offset: 1, Length: 1}}
						h.PositiveDeltas = []int64{1}
					}
					setStart(&h, st, *legacy)
					ts.Histograms = append(ts.Histograms, h)
				}
			}
			if *legacy {
				reflect.ValueOf(&ts).Elem().FieldByName("CreatedTimestamp").SetInt(start)
			}
			req := writev2.Request{Symbols: []string{"", "__name__", name}, Timeseries: []writev2.TimeSeries{ts}}
			wire, err := req.Marshal()
			must(err)
			var decoded writev2.Request
			must(decoded.Unmarshal(wire))
			var observed []any
			for _, s := range decoded.Timeseries[0].Samples {
				observed = append(observed, getStart(s, decoded.Timeseries[0], *legacy))
			}
			for _, h := range decoded.Timeseries[0].Histograms {
				observed = append(observed, getStart(h, decoded.Timeseries[0], *legacy))
			}
			body := snappy.Encode(nil, wire)
			c := map[string]any{"name": name, "kind": kind, "starts_ms": observed, "snappy_base64": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(body)}
			if *receiver != "" {
				r, err := http.NewRequest("POST", *receiver+"/api/v1/write", bytes.NewReader(body))
				must(err)
				r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-protobuf;proto=io.prometheus.write.v2.Request")
				r.Header.Set("Content-Encoding", "snappy")
				r.Header.Set("X-Prometheus-Remote-Write-Version", "2.0.0")
				resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(r)
				must(err)
				b, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
				must(err)
				resp.Body.Close()
				c["status"] = resp.StatusCode
				c["written"] = []string{resp.Header.Get("X-Prometheus-Remote-Write-Samples-Written"), resp.Header.Get("X-Prometheus-Remote-Write-Histograms-Written"), resp.Header.Get("X-Prometheus-Remote-Write-Exemplars-Written")}
				if resp.StatusCode != 204 {
					panic(string(b))
				}
				// A range selector returns actual stored samples, not a
				// lookback-resampled range query. No synthetic zero rows.
				q, err := http.Get(*receiver + "/api/v1/query?time=1700000020&query=" + name + "%5B1m%5D")
				must(err)
				var result map[string]any
				must(json.NewDecoder(q.Body).Decode(&result))
				q.Body.Close()
				c["query"] = result
			}
			cases = append(cases, c)
		}
	}
	e := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	e.SetIndent("", "  ")
	must(e.Encode(cases))
}

func setStart(v any, st int64, legacy bool) {
	if !legacy {
		reflect.ValueOf(v).Elem().FieldByName("StartTimestamp").SetInt(st)
	}
}
func getStart(v any, ts writev2.TimeSeries, legacy bool) any {
	var st int64
	if legacy {
		st = reflect.ValueOf(ts).FieldByName("CreatedTimestamp").Int()
	} else {
		st = reflect.ValueOf(v).FieldByName("StartTimestamp").Int()
	}
	if st == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return st
}
func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
